item.title: Georgia company loses appeal over $220,000 tax auction purchase as county claims sovereign immunity
item.description: Talon Assets, LLC acquired land in Atlanta for $220,000 at a county tax sale. Doubts about the property led them to request a refund and tax deed cancellation. However, Fulton County dismissed their case, invoking sovereign immunity as a legal defense. The Georgia Court of Appeals upheld this dismissal, leaving Talon's issues unresolved. This ruling highlights the challenges in pursuing financial claims against county governments in Georgia. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: Texas farmers turn 640 acres of donated land into college scholarships for 300 students
item.description: A 640-acre farmland donation made to a Texas school district in 1984 has become a source of college scholarships for hundreds of students. Local farmers in Gruver volunteer their labour and equipment to grow crops, generating approximately $400,000 annually. Since 2016, the initiative has distributed nearly $3 million to around 300 students, helping them pursue higher education. Fuente: The Times of India - World.
